observable_contract: For a Desktop source checkout, only an existing explicit interpreter override or that checkout's .venv/venv Python can create a source backend. A source root lacking them returns null so the existing backend ladder can continue. An external explicit override stays the final command and never inherits an unrelated checkout venv's site-packages; a selected checkout venv retains its matching command and packages. System Python remains available to the separately owned active/bootstrap path.
